versions.subject: rule: add user to remote desktop users
versions.detection:
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'net '
        - 'localgroup'
        - 'Remote Desktop Users'
        - '/add'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine="*net *" CommandLine="*localgroup*" CommandLine="*Remote Desktop Users*" CommandLine="*/add*"

versions.subject: Normalization of rule names

    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'net '

versions.spl: CommandLine="*net *" CommandLine="*localgroup*" CommandLine="*Remote Desktop Users*" CommandLine="*/add*"

versions.subject: Big Update
versions.detection:
selection_main:
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'localgroup '
        - ' /add'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Add-LocalGroupMember '
        - ' -Group '
selection_group:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Remote Desktop Users'
        - 'Utilisateurs du Bureau à distance' # French for "Remote Desktop Users"
        - 'Usuarios de escritorio remoto' # Spanish for "Remote Desktop Users"
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*localgroup *" CommandLine="* /add*") OR (CommandLine="*Add-LocalGroupMember *" CommandLine="* -Group *") CommandLine IN ("*Remote Desktop Users*", "*Utilisateurs du Bureau à distance*", "*Usuarios de escritorio remoto*")
